_comment_about_this_file: Managed-policy template for Google Chrome / Chromium / Brave / Arc.
Drop into one of the platform-specific paths below; values land in
chrome.storage.managed and override anything the user set in the popup.
macOS:   converted to a .plist and placed at
<EXTENSION_ID>\policy (REG_SZ values), or via GPO using the
provided ADMX/ADML files in this directory.
Replace <EXTENSION_ID> below with the actual 32-char Chrome extension
ID. For a Chrome Web Store install, the ID is on the listing page. For
a self-hosted install, see docs/enterprise/DEPLOYMENT.md for how to
compute it from the manifest 'key' field.

_comment_about_self_hosted: If you're hosting the extension off-store, change update_url to
your own crx update manifest (an XML file describing the .crx).
Chrome enterprise docs cover the format.

<EXTENSION_ID>._comment: These map 1:1 onto managed-schema.json. See that file for the authoritative property descriptions.
